info.title: Order Hub
info.description:
Order hub for five legacy order sources: ingestion, normalization, entity resolution, golden records and a discrepancy registry.

**Roles:** `admin` — full access, `analyst` — reconcile and resolve issues, `viewer` — read-only. Use `POST /api/v1/auth/token` to get access and refresh tokens.

post.description:
Create a manual order that survives reconciliation.

Generated orders come from the five sources and are rebuilt on every run.
Manual orders use the ``CO-MAN-*`` namespace and an explicit ``manual`` link.
